meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw,用手机短信直接对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 iPhone,想通过短信和助手直接联系。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw and chat via text messages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use iPhone and want to reach your assistant via iMessage.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 iMessage 频道接入 NanoClaw，让你通过它收发 iMessage 消息。它会复制适配器、注册频道、安装依赖，并引导你选择本地或远端模式完成配置。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等关键词，或要求接入 iMessage 时触发。

say.note: 开始复制并注册 iMessage 适配器
需要这台 Mac 授权完全磁盘访问

say.text: 通过 Photon 连接 iMessage
say.note: 让你输入 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw, letting you send and receive iMessage messages through it. Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, and guides you through local or remote setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or when you ask to set up iMessage.

say_en.note: Starts copying and registering the adapter.

say_en.text: Set up iMessage in local mode.
say_en.note: Requires Full Disk Access on this Mac.
Prompts for Photon server URL and API key.
